VBO:0200051.summary: Eager to please and persistent on a scent, the American Leopard Hound is an all-purpose tree dog with a long working stride. It can follow an old track while remaining responsive to its handler’s voice, then hold game at bay. The UKC first recognized it as the Leopard Cur in 1998; its current name followed in 2008.
VBO:0200051.shortDescription: An eager-to-please tree dog with a persistent nose, able to follow an old track and hold game at bay.
